name: Elysian Lounge Seats
process: Each shell is pressed from fine layers of oak veneer in a heated mould, then sanded and oiled by hand to reveal the natural beauty of the grain. The leather is cut from whole hides, stitched with care in our workshop and fitted over frames of bent steel, polished to a mirror-like finish.

name: Lunar Glow Lamps
process: Every steel element is spun, folded and brushed by hand; the glass is mouth-blown, and the ceramic bodies are thrown, glazed and fired twice, so each lamp carries the subtle marks of its making. Each one is wired, tested and fitted with a warm, dimmable light.

name: Tranquil Coffee Tables
process: Every top is cut from tempered glass and patiently polished along its edge until it turns perfectly clear. The bases are cast, turned or bent one at a time and finished by hand, so that no two pieces are ever quite the same.

name: Crescent Edge Armchairs
process: The curved backs are bent from solid oak or moulded in a single piece, then joined to frames of steel or wood with meticulous care. Each seat is upholstered in our workshop with natural fillings and the finest full-grain leathers and suedes.
